recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一群大型非典型細胞，細胞質豐富呈嗜鹼性藍色、部分含小空泡，核不規則、有摺痕或分葉，染色質細緻並可見核仁，大小遠超過旁邊的小淋巴球；這種非典型大細胞群要懷疑淋巴增生性疾病。
features: Cluster of large atypical mononuclear cells with moderate N:C ratio
Irregular, folded, indented to lobulated nuclei
Fine to open chromatin with one or more nucleoli
Abundant basophilic blue cytoplasm, some with small vacuoles
Several crushed/disrupted cells with reticular chromatin; small lymphocytes and a platelet aggregate nearby
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hemodilute and shows a cluster of large atypical mononuclear cells with abundant basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular, folded to lobulated nuclei with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli. Several cells are disrupted. Small mature lymphocytes and platelets are present, and normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. The atypical cells are markedly larger than the background lymphocytes and are not lineage-specific on morphology. In the reported context of EBV positivity in these cells, findings are concerning for an EBV-associated lymphoproliferative disorder, and immunophenotyping on tissue is required.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes also have folded nuclei and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, but they are nonspecific esterase- and CD14/CD64-positive and usually present in greater numbers.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with molding and cytokeratin positivity, whereas these cells are discohesive lymphoid-like cells.
ALCL hallmark cells have kidney- or horseshoe-shaped nuclei with strong CD30 in nearly all cells, while here CD30 is only scattered and ALK is negative.
